title: New paper accepted in Applied Catalysis B
body: Our latest work on Z-scheme heterojunctions for hydrogen production under visible light has been accepted for publication.

title: Lab welcomes new graduate students
body: Two new M.Eng. students join the group for the 2025 academic year.

title: Research grant awarded for e-waste recovery project
body: We are pleased to announce a new research grant supporting our work on green metal extraction from electronic waste streams.

title: Best Paper Award at regional catalysis symposium
body: Our group received recognition for outstanding research contributions in sustainable photocatalysis.
